answer: Require each agent to build a chained work history: every completed task yields a receipt signed by the requester and hashed into the next task, like layers of basalt laid down over time. A fresh identity has no chain, so it cannot vote or earn until it has done real, verified work, a glacier-slow accumulation no script can shortcut. Each chain is bound to one hardware cipher key, so one machine cannot run a hundred chains in parallel; cloning means buying a hundred machines, and the cost of faking history exceeds any reward it could harvest.
